evidence: Reorganizes wallet classes, moving legacy loading and migration logic into `src/wallet/legacy/` under `wallet::legacy_migration` and deriving `LegacyWallet` from `CWallet`.
rationale: Isolating legacy migration code prevents obsolete routines from tangling with active descriptor wallet development. The author notes that 'co-mingling of never-to-be-changed legacy wallet code and new descriptor wallet code makes it difficult to implement new things', but the change is primarily structural maintenance rather than a fix for migration correctness or fund safety.
